description:
As a group organiser I want to add breakfast to my quote, so the price I see already includes it.

Acceptance criteria:
- Each room line on a quote has an optional `breakfast` flag; lines without it keep today's price.
- Breakfast costs €18 per room per night.
- The quote total includes breakfast for the lines that have it.
- GET /api/v1/quotes/{id} returns the flag with each room line.

comments.author: maria-pm
comments.body: Price confirmed with revenue: €18 per room per night, same in every hotel for now.
